problem: How should a useful assistant grow into an advanced architecture?
principle: Start from one task. Add components for demonstrated state, recovery, concurrency and isolation requirements.
check: When is a queue more useful than another agent?
answer: When the problem is asynchronous ownership, concurrency or recovery, not an additional reasoning role.

procedures.state: Domain objects, service boundaries and replaceable adapters.
procedures.failure: Avoid framework/model types leaking through every business layer.
procedures.measure: Swap a model/tool while preserving business rules.
procedures.case: Direct SDK and MCP use the same quotation authorization.

procedures.state: Workflow ID, code version, approval, activities and receipts.
procedures.failure: Framework state is not remote business truth; version replay intentionally.
procedures.measure: Restart processes without losing approval/effect boundaries.
procedures.case: Resume next-day approval from verified research evidence.

procedures.state: Task, Outbox, lease/fencing, operation record and version.
procedures.failure: A crash after send causes redelivery; consumers/remote systems deduplicate.
procedures.measure: Crash windows, stale-worker rejection, backlog and recovery latency.
procedures.case: Publisher retries still reference the same draft operation key.

media.title: Complete architecture: ingress to delivery and operational feedback
media.alt: Complete multi-Agent studio system: control, execution, data and external boundaries
media.caption: Complete reference design, 3600px wide; click to enlarge. Follow intake → orchestration → agents → Host → workers/external systems → artifacts/receipts → review/delivery. Then inspect authority, context, durable state and operational support. Boxes express responsibilities, not mandatory microservices or a claim that ForgePilot deploys every component.

scope: The complete diagram is a reference architecture. The code demonstrates layered in-process read-only quotation composition; the depicted services, queues and isolation facilities are not all deployed.
